stem: A coworker made an undocumented correction to a fertigation batch before the final reading. What is the strongest Technician II response?
choices: Create a clean record showing only the final values
Ignore the adjustment if the final EC is acceptable
Reconstruct and document the actual event, identify the incomplete batch history and escalate under the deviation procedure
rationale: Quality records must preserve what actually happened; undocumented corrections create an incomplete process history that must be addressed transparently.
